I have $1086 and two properties. I paid $50 to leave jail and $14 in rent. p2 owns pink and red properties. p3 owns orange. p4 owns orange. The pink color group is split.

The best trade is Indiana for St. Charles. This gives me two pinks and leaves Virginia unowned so I can complete the set. p2 would have Kentucky and Indiana, but they cannot finish the red group without p3's Illinois. I am unsure if p2 will accept this offer.

I am weighing whether to accept p2's pink-for-red offer or instead pay cash for St. Charles while keeping Indiana. I have only two properties, so a cash deal would require giving up Indiana.

A cash offer for St. Charles would likely be rejected because p2 knows the property is essential for completing their pink group. The swap they proposed is more promising since they explicitly invited it. I am now deciding whether to offer Indiana for St. Charles or States for Kentucky.

The swap would give me two pinks and p2 two reds. Virginia is unowned, so completing the pink group is easy. Illinois is owned by p3, so finishing the red group is difficult. I should try to acquire the pinks.

I will propose an even swap: Indiana Avenue for St. Charles Place. Indiana is worth $220 versus St. Charles at $140, so I am giving up the more expensive property. I may add a small cash bonus if needed. I am also considering trading with p3.

I will not mortgage any properties. I am ready to propose the trade to p2.
